overview.description: The Deutsche Bank Ag London Gold Double Short Exchange Traded (Nts) (DZZ) is an exchange-traded product that mostly invests in gold commodities. The fund provides -2x the daily performance of futures contracts relating to gold. The notes index selects contracts based on the shape of the futures curve to minimize contango. DZZ was launched on Feb 27, 2008 and is issued by DB.
